stages.prompt: We need an editorial database: Writer { name, stories } and Story { headline, draft, writer }. Name and headline are text; draft is true/false. One writer has many stories and each story has one writer. Make both sides navigable. The headline also needs English word search with BM25; this is keyword relevance, not vector similarity.

params.name: schema
params.sdl: type Writer { name: String stories: [Story] } type Story { headline: String @fulltext(language:"english") draft: Boolean writer: Writer }
